errors.evidence: The description states that the years are arranged in alphabetical order, but the figure shows the years arranged chronologically from 2013 to 2022.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates vineyard areas in thousands of hectares for different countries over the period 2013–2022.

The description does not mention that Spain consistently has the highest values (around 950 thousand hectares) and Argentina the lowest (around 200 thousand hectares), nor does it note that the values remain constant for all countries throughout the period.
